description: This file defines a Java interface 'CommandsTopicPathBuilder' for building command topic paths. It extends 'TopicPathBuildable' and provides chainable methods to set different actions (create, retrieve, modify, delete) for the command topics.

classes.name: CommandsTopicPathBuilder
classes.description: An interface for building command topic paths with specific actions (create, retrieve, modify, delete). It allows method chaining and is designed for extension.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Sets the action to 'CREATE' and returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: retrieve
methods.description: Sets the action to 'RETRIEVE' and returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: modify
methods.description: Sets the action to 'MODIFY' and returns the builder for chaining.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Sets the action to 'DELETE' and returns the builder for chaining.
